Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

randomForestSGT 2.0.0

New features

  • Added node centering (node.center = TRUE) before forming polynomial and interaction terms, with support in fitting, prediction, filtering, and tuning.

  • Added restricted lasso predictions (node.restrict = TRUE), which clamp predictors and scores to each node's inbag predictor and response ranges. Applies to OOB and new-data predictions; predict() can override the saved setting. Older forests without this setting remain unrestricted by default.

  • Added cv.rfsgt() and make.folds() for cross-validation with reusable folds and per-fold seeds. Filtering and optional hcut tuning are repeated within each training fold, with held-out predictions and error summaries returned.

  • Added plot.rfsgt() for per-tree OOB risk curves and comparisons of forest OOB error across tree sizes.

  • Extended get.beta() to report centered-model coefficients in the original coordinates, including induced lower-order terms. Restricted predictions are reconstructed from term contributions plus response.adjustment.

  • Added relaxed coefficient estimation with get.beta(..., relaxed = TRUE) using OOB least squares, global or local active terms, standard errors, and leave-one-out predictions for training observations.

  • Added partial.beta() for variable-effect plots and importance.beta() for marginal and conditional importance summaries based on those effects.

Changes to defaults and behavior

  • Changed the default hcut from 1 to 2, enabling quadratic terms and variable filtering by default.

  • Centered fits now default to bsf = "inbag"; uncentered fits with hcut > 0 retain bsf = "oob". tune.hcut() now defaults to bsf = "inbag". Fitting with a tuning result inherits its centering and BSF settings unless explicitly overridden.

  • Reduced the default tree-size limit for hcut >= 2 from min(100, n/5) to min(25, n/5), and changed the grow block.size default from 10 to 1.

  • Changed the get.beta() default from bag = "inbag" to bag = "oob".

  • Revised random-seed initialization; results for a fixed seed can differ from version 1.0.0.

  • Printed fits now report node centering and restriction settings and flag potentially optimistic OOB error when variable filtering was used.

Fixes and robustness

  • Preserved source predictors and term maps needed to reconstruct retained polynomial terms after filtering, including during tuning and prediction.

  • Corrected saved-forest restoration of terminal membership and inbag counts, including repeated bootstrap draws, and preserved CART fallback and split types when saving trees.

  • Corrected forest offsets for predictions using selected trees (get.tree).

  • Improved get.beta() handling of restored objects and observations without contributing trees, preserving missing predictions instead of returning zero.

  • Strengthened validation of saved forest dimensions and membership output, widened native array-length and offset calculations, and released native allocations used by custom bootstrap samples.

  • Improved the SGT-importance fallback when varPro screening fails or returns no result.
